mapper.select: SELECT r.rf_id,r.p_id,r.rf_status,TO_CHAR(rf_done_at,'yyyy-mm-dd') as doneday,TO_char(rf_requested_at,'yyyy-mm-dd') as reqday, pl.name as pname FROM refund r JOIN pay p ON r.p_id=p.p_id JOIN reserve re ON p.rvno=re.rvno JOIN place pl ON re.pno=pl.pno WHERE re.uno=#{uno} ORDER BY rf_id DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 8 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/8.0) FROM refund r JOIN pay p ON r.p_id=p.p_id JOIN reserve re ON p.rvno=re.rvno WHERE re.uno=#{uno}
